n276d29c51d.headline: Czechs now earn on average almost thirty thousand crowns. Median wage grows even faster | Aktuálně.cz
n276d29c51d.summary: The average wage in the Czech Republic reached 29,320 crowns in Q4, with the median wage exceeding 25,000 crowns for the first time.
n276d29c51d.why: Rising wages indicate economic growth and increased consumer purchasing power, influencing domestic demand and investment.
